free_tier.stated: 1 TB – 100 TB per account, 30 M objects per bucket

egress.terms: Verbatim: 'Ingress is free and unlimited.' / 'Egress includes 10 TB per 1 TB of storage.' / '10 TB egress included per 1 TB of booked storage.' At 20 TB booked that is 200 TB/mo included — 6.6× the client's 30 TB/mo serving load. Egress beyond the 10:1 ratio is not priced on the page.

tooling: any S3 SDK, rclone, s3cmd, restic
chaining: native S3 → Cloudflare in front → presigned URLs; no wrapper needed
limits_note: Prepaid / TB-based (not pay-as-you-go) — you pay for booked capacity even if empty. 100 TB account cap.
reliability_note: Small German host (AS203446), Equinix FRA-05/07/08. Payment methods verified on their KVM page: PayPal, credit card, Sofort, Giropay, EPS, Paysafecard, Przelewy24, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Alipay, Monero, bank transfer. Best payment friction profile of any EU host here for a non-EU buyer.
